我们的帆船俱乐部每月出一期内部通讯。

en: a male journalist who works for a newspaper or a television or radio station

一群记者和电视新闻采编人员

zh: a television news programme that is broadcast in Britain on BBC Two late every evening from Monday to Friday. It usually includes a serious discussion about an important news item. Its aim is ‘to make sense of the day's news, to try to explain the detail of current events and hold to account those responsible for them’. Some of its presenters are well known for asking politicians difficult questions.
